description: This file defines the AttendanceRecordAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing attendance records in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for retrieving and updating individual attendance records, including validation, permission checks, and overlapping record checks. The class uses traits for authentication and date/time handling, and it interacts with the Attendance service layer to perform business logic operations.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordAPI
classes.description: REST API class for handling attendance record retrieval and updates, including validation, permission checks, and overlapping record detection.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attendance record by ID, verifies permissions, and returns detailed information.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing attendance record after validation and permission checks.

methods.name: isAuthUserAllowedToPerformTheActions
methods.description: Checks if the authenticated user has permission to perform actions on the specified attendance record.

methods.name: setAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Sets the punch-in and punch-out details on an attendance record based on request parameters, including overlap validation.

methods.name: getRequestBodyParams
methods.description: Extracts punch in/out data from the request body payload.

methods.name: extractPunchDateTime
methods.description: Creates a DateTime object from a date/time string and a timezone offset.

methods.name: isAllowedToEditTimezone
methods.description: Validates whether timezone offset and name are valid and both provided.
